caption: The drawing depicts three views of a circular object, likely a compass or surveying instrument, with a protective case. The main object in the center shows the device with its lid open, revealing a glass-covered dial with Roman numerals and two vertical sights made of brass or gold-toned metal. The bowl and the lid's interior are lined with a reddish-brown material, while the exterior of the case appears black and textured. To the lower left, there is a top-down view of the instrument, showing the dial in greater detail with the needle and measurement markings within a yellow or brass ring. On the right side of the drawing is a closed view of the case, emphasizing its worn black exterior and an oval patch of missing material on the lid, exposing a lighter color beneath. The objects are arranged on a plain, light beige background, and the drawing is rendered with detailed color and shading for a realistic effect.
title: Hand Compass
